summary: Verified root-cause fix for the Saarthi voice-assistant infinite reconnect loop. Ran the provided regression script test_voice_proxy_bigframe.py against the proxy backend with a local mock upstream emitting a ~1.28 MB AUDIO_CHUNK frame. With max_size=None on websockets.connect() in app/services/voice_service.py, the proxy forwarded the oversized frame intact (big_len=1280000, got_error=false) -> PASS. As a regression-guard sanity check, temporarily removed max_size=None and re-ran; the test failed exactly as the user reported with ERROR {code:UPSTREAM_ERROR, message:'Upstream closed connection'} and got_big=false, then restored the fix. Confirms the 1 MiB websockets default frame cap was the true root cause of the reconnect loop.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: max_size=None on websockets.connect() lifts the 1 MiB client-side frame cap that was closing the upstream leg on the cached greeting audio.

Defense-in-depth chunking (~48 KB sub-chunks) added on the AI-engine cache-hit path in voice_response_pipeline.py is a good belt-and-braces measure so future clients/proxies with default caps also work.
Recommend adding this regression test to CI so any future removal of max_size=None (or upstream default change) is caught automatically.
STT accuracy and audio echo concerns raised by the user are out of scope for this fix and were not (and could not be) validated here without Inworld/Groq/Gemini keys.
test_credentials: None required. Mock upstream used; no Inworld keys needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression script at '/app/final backend mantrasetu/mantrasetu-saarthi-backend-main/test_voice_proxy_bigframe.py'. Run: cd '/app/final backend mantrasetu/mantrasetu-saarthi-backend-main' && /root/.venv/bin/python test_voice_proxy_bigframe.py . Expected: RESULT {got_big: true, got_error: false, big_len: 1280000} + PASS line. No API keys needed. Full 3-tier voice flow (real Inworld) cannot be exercised in this pod.
rca of the issue: Proxy backend's outbound websockets.connect() to the AI intent-engine used python-websockets default max_size=1 MiB. AI engine emitted the cached greeting TTS as a single AUDIO_CHUNK with ~1.28 MB base64 audio, exceeding 1 MiB. websockets client aborted upstream with close 1009 ('message too big'). Proxy translated that to ERROR {code:UPSTREAM_ERROR, message:'Upstream closed connection'} and closed 1006. Client auto-reconnect hit the same cached greeting -> infinite loop. Fix: max_size=None on websockets.connect() in app/services/voice_service.py (+ ping_interval=20, ping_timeout=60). Defense-in-depth: AI engine now streams cached greeting as ~48KB sub-chunks. Verified in both directions (with fix -> PASS forwarding 1,280,000 byte frame; without fix -> exact UPSTREAM_ERROR reproduced).
